prop16AllObjects.191: My Kinda Dock! => Now THIS Is My Kind of Dock

tail:
rt. Off to the west, docks straddle a deep canal. On the far shore, sand dunes lap at crumbling buildings. On the top step of a winding stair is a black circle.
   Trent enters just a few steps behind you.
 
>stand on circle
You're sucked into the hole in a direction that isn't down, but neither is it one of the other directions with which you're familiar.
 
It's too dark to see a thing.
   A few seconds later, you feel Trent's big toe appear, followed almost immediately by the rest of him.
 
>
